verdict.rationale: The firm's dedicated 'Seed, venture and growth financings' page states deal volume: 1,600+ venture financings and $45B+ raised for company clients since 2023, plus 12 consecutive years as PitchBook's most active VC law firm. Its late-stage page adds $100B+ of financings since 2020 and a representative transaction, the lead investors in Anthropic's $65B Series H, so the practice spans seed through late stage. Missing for 10: explicit first-party description of priced preferred-equity round work (term sheets, preferred stock terms) as distinct from SAFEs, and named representative company-side priced rounds at seed and early stage, since the cited deals are investor-side.
